CustomField.description: Not a setting: when the last nightly rollup run that finished started. The next night recalculates the targets of source records changed since then (D-200 P1). Blank means the next night recalculates everything. Written by the engine only; not shown in the settings console.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Used by BarnCRM to know which changes the nightly rollup run has already covered.
CustomField.label: Nightly Covered From
